summary: Tested the api.js base URL logic and the relative share redirect. The browser run on https://weave-him-bloom.internal.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844 passed. The husband-counter showed '27 husbands woven by hand'. The full flow went /strand/1 to /strand/7, then /weaving, then /meet/k64tdq6v with vow-1..vow-5 and no vow-6. The share-card text contains '(Weave yours at weave-him-bloom.internal.preview.emergentagent.com)', i.e. window.location.host. Visiting /api/share/{id} landed on /h/{id} on the same host, with 5 vows and weave-your-own-button. All 6 API requests went to the page's own host, and there were no page errors. GET /api/share/{id} returns HTML with meta refresh '0;url=/h/{id}', location.replace("/h/{id}") and href="/h/{id}", all relative. og:image and og:url are still absolute. An unknown id returns 404. The public host gives a Cloudflare 307: curl https://weave-him-bloom.preview.emergentagent.com/ returns HTTP/2 307 with 'location: https://weave-him-bloom.internal.preview.emergentagent.com/' and 'server: cloudflare'. /api/stats on the public host also returns 307 to the .internal /api/stats. This redirect comes from the platform edge, not the app.
action_items: No app code fix is needed. The public preview domain issues a Cloudflare-level 307 to the .internal host, including for /api/*. This is platform or ingress configuration that the app cannot override. Tell the user, or redeploy or check the preview environment's routing.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL itself points to the .internal host. api.js ignores it unless the hosts match, so this is harmless, but the value is protected and was left alone.
Two outbound navigations are user-initiated shares, not redirects: shareLink uses window.location.origin, which is correct, and Tell.jsx sends window.location.href to sms: or wa.me.
og:url and og:image use the x-forwarded-host, so they will be absolute .internal URLs when the request is served via .internal. That is expected given the platform redirect.
seed_data_creation: 1 husband (k64tdq6v) created via the UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: SHARE_TEST_ID=<existing id> REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_share_relative.py -n 0. Without SHARE_TEST_ID the share test is skipped. The public host currently returns a 307 to .internal at Cloudflare.
